config.name: hf-inference
config.description: Manage Hugging Face Inference Endpoints: list, inspect, create, update, delete, pause, resume, scale to zero, and read logs. Set $HF_TOKEN to a Hugging Face access token.

preconditions.precondition: {{ if not .var.token }}set HF_TOKEN to a Hugging Face access token{{ end }}

command.name: list
command.description: List the Inference Endpoints in a namespace.

flag.name: search
flag.description: Only endpoints whose name contains this text.

flag.name: state
flag.description: Comma-separated states: pending, initializing, updating, updateFailed, running, paused, failed, scaledToZero.

flag.name: type
flag.description: Comma-separated types: public, authenticated, private.

flag.name: task
flag.description: Comma-separated model tasks, such as text-generation.

flag.name: tags
flag.description: Comma-separated tags.

flag.name: sort
flag.description: createdAt (the API default), updatedAt or name.

flag.name: direction
flag.description: asc, or desc (the API default).

flag.name: limit
flag.description: Endpoints per page.

flag.name: cursor
flag.description: The page to read, from the footer of the previous page.

command.name: get
command.description: Fetch one Inference Endpoint: its state, URL, model and compute.

command.name: create
command.description: Create an Inference Endpoint. `hf endpoints hardware` lists the valid vendor, region, accelerator, instance type and size combinations.

arg.name: name
arg.description: Endpoint name: lowercase letters, digits and '-', 32 characters at most.

flag.name: repository
flag.description: Model repository, such as meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

flag.name: framework
flag.description: Framework, such as pytorch, vllm or custom.

flag.name: accelerator
flag.description: cpu, gpu or neuron.

flag.name: instance-type
flag.description: Instance type, such as nvidia-l4 or intel-spr.

flag.name: instance-size
flag.description: Instance size, such as x1 or x4.

flag.name: vendor
flag.description: Cloud vendor, such as aws or gcp.

flag.name: region
flag.description: Cloud region, such as us-east-1.

flag.name: type
flag.description: Access type: public (no token), authenticated (any Hugging Face token) or private (AWS PrivateLink only).

flag.name: task
flag.description: Model task, such as text-generation.

flag.name: revision
flag.description: Model commit or branch. The API takes the latest main without it.

flag.name: min-replica
flag.description: Fewest replicas. 0 lets the endpoint scale to zero.

flag.name: max-replica
flag.description: Most replicas.

flag.name: scale-to-zero-timeout
flag.description: Idle minutes before the endpoint scales to zero. Sent only with --min-replica 0.

flag.name: image
flag.description: The model.image object as JSON, such as {"custom":{"url":"ghcr.io/org/image:tag","port":8080}}.

flag.name: tag
flag.description: An endpoint tag. Repeat it for more than one.

command.name: update
command.description: Change an Inference Endpoint. Only the flags given change.

flag.name: repository
flag.description: Model repository.

flag.name: framework
flag.description: Framework, such as pytorch, vllm or custom.

flag.name: revision
flag.description: Model commit or branch.

flag.name: task
flag.description: Model task.

flag.name: image
flag.description: The model.image object as JSON.

flag.name: accelerator
flag.description: cpu, gpu or neuron.

flag.name: instance-type
flag.description: Instance type.

flag.name: instance-size
flag.description: Instance size.

flag.name: min-replica
flag.description: Fewest replicas. -1 leaves it as it is.

flag.name: max-replica
flag.description: Most replicas. -1 leaves it as it is.

flag.name: scale-to-zero-timeout
flag.description: Idle minutes before the endpoint scales to zero. -1 leaves it as it is.

flag.name: type
flag.description: Access type: public, authenticated or private.

flag.name: tag
flag.description: An endpoint tag. Repeat it for more than one. The list replaces the current tags.

command.name: delete
command.description: Delete an Inference Endpoint. This cannot be undone. pause or scale-to-zero stops the billing and keeps the endpoint.
command.confirm: Delete the Inference Endpoint {{ .arg.namespace }}/{{ .arg.name }}? This cannot be undone.

command.name: pause
command.description: Pause an Inference Endpoint. A paused endpoint does not bill and stays down until resume.

command.name: resume
command.description: Resume a paused or stopped Inference Endpoint. The API answers 400 for an endpoint that already runs.

command.name: scale-to-zero
command.description: Scale an Inference Endpoint to zero replicas. The next request wakes it. The endpoint needs a scale-to-zero timeout.

command.name: logs
command.description: Read the logs of an Inference Endpoint.

flag.name: replica
flag.description: Only this replica.

flag.name: tail
flag.description: The most lines to return. 0 sends no limit.

flag.name: line-max-length
flag.description: Cut each line at this length. 0 sends no limit.
